z-m-04-01.title: Kadhi rinotevera rinotorwa rinogona kuva chii?
z-m-04-01.goal: Kadhi rega rega painotorwa, simbisa uye utaure kuti 'rinogona kuuya / harigoni kuuya / rinofanira kuuya' nechikonzero.
z-m-04-01.material: Mubhokisi mune makadhi enhamba 6, ane 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ne6 akanyorwa pamusoro, rimwe nerimwe. Shure kwemakadhi ose akafanana, saka unotora rimwe panguva wakavhara maziso. Mushure mekutarisa kumberi kwekadhi rakatorwa, unoriisa padivi uye hauridzorere mubhokisi. Zviziviso zviri pazasi zvinovhurwa rimwe panguva.
z-m-04-01.thinking.2: Kupokana nezvikonzero zvinonzwika zvakanaka senge saizi kana kurongeka
z-m-04-01.prereq.0: Kuziva nhamba kubva ku1 kusvika ku10 nekusiyanisa odd ne even (nhanho yeGrade 1)
z-m-04-01.s.s1.prompt: Zviziviso zvinovhurwa rimwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza chirevo chakarurama.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kune chiziviso chimwe nechimwe, tanga wanyora 'makadhi api asara mubhokisi zvino'.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana chirevo chawakasarudza chakarurama chaizvo nekushanda, kune kadhi rega rega rasara, kana rinogona kuuya.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Hapana kadhi rakatorwa parizvino. Funga nezvekadhi rekutanga raunotora.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kadhi rega rega mubhokisi rinogona kuuya, uye kadhi risiri mubhokisi, senge 7, harigoni kuuya. Haugoni kusarudza pachine nguva kuti kadhi ripi rinouya.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaona kuti pane 5 mubhokisi, saka inogona kuuya. Pfungwa yakanaka kutanga watarisa makadhi aripo.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Mubhokisi mune makadhi 1 kusvika ku6 chete. Tarisazve kana kadhi risiri mubhokisi rinogona kuuya.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kana ukatora wakavhara maziso, haugoni kusarudza pachine nguva kuti kadhi ripi richava. 'Rinogona kuuya' ne 'rinofanira kuuya' zvakasiyana.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kadhi rinouya ndere rimwe re1 kusvika ku6
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wakaenda pamakadhi ose ari mubhokisi uye ukataura renji rezvinogona kuuya. Hauna kusarudza nhamba.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Wakatora makadhi maviri ukawana 5 ne2. Wakaisa makadhi maviri padivi uye haana kuadzorera mubhokisi. Zvino funga nezvekadhi rechitatu raunotora.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.after: 5 ne2 dzakabuda mubhokisi uye hadzidzoki. Saka 5 haichagoni kuuya, uye makadhi asara 1, 3, 4, ne6 ose anogona kuuya. Ruzivo rutsva rwakachinja imwe yepfungwa dzekutanga.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakafunga nezvemamiriro sezvaiva pakutanga. Tarisa kwakaenda 5 zvino.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 5 ne2 dzakauya, saka panguva ino ndiyo nguva ya1 nenhevedzano
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hapana 'nguva' yakatarwa. Kana ukatora wakavhara maziso, kadhi rega rega rasara rinogona kuuya.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatarisa makadhi asara mubhokisi chete, uchisiya makadhi akaiswa padivi. Wakashandisa ruzivo rutsva mukutonga kwako.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: 5 ne2 dzatouya, saka panguva ino 6 inofanira kuuya
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Nekuti mamwe makadhi atouya, kadhi rinotevera harina kutarwa. Tarisa kuti makadhi mangani asara.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.info: 4 yakauya sekadhi rechitatu. Wakaisa 4 padivi zvakare. Zvino makadhi matatu, 1, 3, ne6, asara mubhokisi.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sarudza chirevo chakarurama nezvekadhi rechina raunotora.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Pakati pemakadhi asara 1, 3, 6, pane odd (1, 3) ne even (6). Saka zvose zvinogona kuuya. Kunyange makadhi ari mashoma, ichiri chokwadi kuti haugoni kusarudza pachine nguva kuti kadhi ripi rinouya.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tarisa imwe imwe kana pane nhamba even pakati pemakadhi asara.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 6 inhamba hombe zvikuru, saka 6 ndiyo inonyanya kuuya
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Nhamba hombe haitorwi nyore. Kumashure kwemakadhi ose kwakafanana uye unotora wakavhara maziso.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 4 yakaiswa padivi. Tarisa kana 4 iri mubhokisi zvino.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kadhi re odd nekadhi re even zvose zvinogona kuuya
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakatarisa chokwadi chekuti pane nhamba odd ne even pakati pe1, 3, 6 dzasara.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.reflect: Pfungwa yako yekuti 5 inogona kuuya yakachinja sei mushure mekuti 5 yaiswa padivi? Uye chirevo chipi chakaramba chakadaro kunyange mushure mekuti makadhi akawanda atorwa?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.prompt: Shamwari yakati, "Makadhi asara ndi1, 3, ne6, saka hombe, 6, ichauya!" Ungaudza shamwari iyi chii?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kana zvakanaka kuchinja "ichauya" mumashoko eshamwari yako kuita "inogona kuuya".
z-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.1: Shanda kana zvisingagoneki chaizvo kuti kadhi risiri 6 rive rinouya pakati pemakadhi matatu asara.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Musiyano pakati pe 'inogona kuuya' ne 'inofanira kuuya' unoonekwa mukutaura kwangu here?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakafunga here kuti mamwe makadhi pakati pe1, 3, 6 asara anogonawo kuuya?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.0: 6 inogona kuuya, asi haifaniri. 1 kana 3 dzinogona kuuya.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.1: Nhamba hombe haitorwi nyore. Unotora wakavhara maziso, saka haugoni kuziva kadhi ripi richauya.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.2: 6 inogona kuuya, asi zvisingafaniri. 1 kana 3 dzinogona kuuyawo.

z-m-04-03.title: Mavara anovanza bhokisi rimwe
z-m-04-03.topic: Data rakavanzwa mutebhura: chii chimwe chatinoda kuriwana?
z-m-04-03.goal: Sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kuziva bhokisi rimwe retebhura (huwandu hwose, kana munhu wega wega akasarudza chinhu chimwe chete), uye utaure kuti mhinduro inochinja sei kana ruzivo rutsva rwunouya.
z-m-04-03.material: Shamwari dzemukirasi yedu dzakasarudza rudzi rumwe rwemotokari rwadzinoda. Peturu rakadonha pabhokisi rimwe retebhura yetsvakurudzo, saka haringaonekwi. [Tebhura] Motokari 6 / Chitima □ (hachiwoneki) / Ndege 4 / Ngarava 2. Unoda kuziva nhamba inoenda mubhokisi risina chinhu (□).
z-m-04-03.thinking.2: Kugadzirisa kutonga kwako nekuisa ruzivo rutsva
z-m-04-03.prereq.0: Kuwedzera nekubvisa nhamba dzinosvika pa20 (ukuru hwegiredhi 1)
z-m-04-03.prereq.1: Kuverenga nhamba yevanhu mubhokisi rega rega retebhura
z-m-04-03.s.s1.prompt: Chii chimwe chaunoda kuziva kuti uwane nhamba inoenda mu □? Sarudza zvose zvakarurama.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga waongorora nhamba dzose dziri mumabhokisi anozivikanwa mutebhura.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti nhamba iyoyo inofanira kubatana sei nekirasi yose.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.a: Boka ripi ravakasarudza ndege 4 vari mariri
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.a: Ani ari muboka ripi hakuna chekuita nenhamba iri mu □. Tarisa zvakare ruzivo rwaunoda kusarudza nhamba.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.b: Hurefu hahuna chekuita nenhamba iri mu □. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rupi rwaizokubvumidza kusarudza nhamba.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakaedza kuenzanisa huwandu hwetebhura nemabhokisi anozivikanwa.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.d: Kana nhamba dziri mumaseru matatu anozivikanwa (motokari, ndege, ngarava) dzakarurama
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.d: Nhamba dziri mumaseru anozivikanwa dzatovapo mutebhura. Kusarudza □, unoda ruzivo rusiri mutebhura.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.e: Kana munhu wega wega akasarudza chinhu chimwe chete
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.e: Wakaedza kuongorora kuti hapana anoonekwa mumabhokisi maviri.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.explain: Kana uchiziva huwandu hwevanhu mukirasi uye kuti munhu wega wega akasarudza chinhu chimwe chete, nhamba inosara mushure mekubvisa maseru matatu anozivikanwa i □. Kuziva hurefu kana zita reshamwari yakasarudza chitima, kana kungoongorora zvakare maseru anozivikanwa, hazvigoni kusarudza □.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.prompt: Mudzidzisi akakuudza. "Tiri 15 mukirasi yedu. Shamwari imwe haina kuuya nhasi, saka hatina kugona kuongorora shamwari iyoyo. Shamwari dzose dzakaongororwa dzakasarudza chinhu chimwe chete." □ i yangani?
z-m-04-03.s.s2.hint.0: Shamwari isina kuuya haioneki chero kupi mutebhura. Tanga wasarudza kuti vanhu vangani vanofanira kuoneka mutebhura.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba iyoyo nenhamba dziri mumabhokisi matatu anozivikanwa.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.a: Zvinoita sewakashandisa kirasi yose ye15 sezvayakaita. Ongorora ruzivo rwekuti pane shamwari isina kuongororwa.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.b: Zvino unoziva huwandu hwevanhu uye kuti mumwe nemumwe akasarudza chinhu chimwe chete. Ongorora zvakare kana ruzivo urwu runokubvumidza kusarudza □.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.c: Wakaenzanisa mabhokisi anozivikanwa nenhamba yevanhu vakaongororwa. Wakashandisa ruzivo rwekuti shamwari imwe haina kuuya.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.d: Ongorora zvawakasiya pakuverenga nhamba dziri mumabhokisi anozivikanwa.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.explain: Shamwari dzakaongororwa i14, iri 15 kubvisa 1 isina kuuya. Mabhokisi anozivikanwa i 6 + 4 + 2 = 12, saka □ i 14 − 12 = 2.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.prompt: Dai shamwari imwe zvakare yanga isina kuuya, shamwari dzingani dzaizosarudza chitima? Nyora kuti wakaziva sei.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga zvakare kuti huwandu hwose hwawakashandisa kuwana □ hwaiva hupi.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga wataura kuti huwandu uhwu hunochinja sei kana shamwari imwe zvakare isingauye.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nhamba dzandakanyora dzakashandisa zvose nhamba dziri mumabhokisi matatu anozivikanwa nenhamba yevanhu vakaongororwa here?
z-m-04-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura kuti nei □ chete inochinja, kwete mamwe mabhokisi, kana shamwari imwe zvakare isingauye here?
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.0: 1. Shamwari dzakaongororwa dzinoderera ne1 kusvika pa13, saka mushure mekubatanidza 6, 4, ne2 dzinozivikanwa, zvinosara i1.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.modelNote.0: Yakatsanangurwa ne13 kubvisa 12 dzakaverengwa mumabhokisi ose anozivikanwa, nhamba inosara
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.1: Rimwe. Huwandu hwose hwakadzika ne1 asi mamwe mabhokisi anoramba akadaro, saka bhokisi rechitima rinodzika ne1.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.2: Munhu 1. Nhamba yevanhu vakaongororwa inova 13 uye maseru anozivikanwa i12, saka 13-12=1.

z-m-04-02.title: Kana ndikaverenga, nhamba dzeshamwari mbiri dzakasiyana
z-m-04-02.topic: Kuverenga pasina chinosiiwa: kuwana kwakaenda zvisirizvo kuverenga
z-m-04-02.goal: Kana kuverenga kwevanhu vaviri kwakasiyana, shandisa nhamba iri mumutsara wega wega sehumbowo, dzidza kuti hapana angava akarurama, wana kukanganisa uye utaure nzira yekuverenga inodzivirira kukanganisa kumwe chete.
z-m-04-02.material: Patafura pane masitikari enyeredzi akafanana mumitsara mitatu. Mutsara wepamusoro une 5, wepakati une 6, uye wepazasi une 5. Jihu naNari vakaverenga kuti pane masitikari mangani pamwe chete. Jihu akati 15, uye Nari akati 17. Unoda kuziva kuti ndeupi pashamwari mbiri akarurama.
z-m-04-02.thinking.0: Kuongorora nehumbowo (nhamba iri mumutsara wega wega) kana migumisiro yakasiyana
z-m-04-02.thinking.2: Kufungidzira nzira dzekudzivirira kusiya nekuverenga kaviri
z-m-04-02.prereq.0: Kuverenga nhamba dzinosvika pa20 nenzira (ukuru hwegiredhi 1)
z-m-04-02.prereq.1: Kuverenga mutsara wega wega wega uye kuunyora
z-m-04-02.s.s1.prompt: Tarisa nhamba dzakaverengwa neshamwari mbiri uye usarudze chirevo chakarurama.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti pane mangani mumutsara wega wega.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana huwandu hwekuverenga mitsara yose mitatu huchienzana nenhamba dzakaverengwa neshamwari mbiri.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.a: Nhamba diki haifanire kuva yakarurama. Ongorora zvinoitika kana ukaunganidza nhamba dziri mumutsara wega wega.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.b: Wakaongorora nhamba dzose mbiri uchishandisa nhamba iri mumutsara wega wega.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.c: Wakafunga kuti ane akaverenga akawanda haana kusiya. Asi unogona kuverenga sitikari imwe chete kaviri.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.d: Nhamba iri mumutsara wega wega yatozivikanwa. Tarisa zvakare kana unogona kuongorora nayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaverenga mutsara wepamusoro 5, wepakati 6, uye wepazasi 5, pane 16. Kunyange 15 yakaverengwa naJihu kana 17 yakaverengwa naNari hazvina kururama. Shamwari dzose mbiri dzakakanganisa kwakati pakuverenga.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.prompt: Izvi ndizvo zvakaverengwa naJihu achitaura. Sarudza mutsara wakaipa.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kuti pane zvakaverengwa zvingani mumutsara wega wega uye uzvienzanise nenhamba inozivikanwa.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mumashoko akashandiswa kuverenga mutsara wepazasi, nongedza nemunwe kuona kuti zvakaverengwa zvingani.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.0: Akaverenga mutsara wepamusoro kubva kuruboshwe: rimwe, maviri, matatu, mana, mashanu.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.1: Akaverenga mutsara wepakati kubva kuruboshwe, achienderera: matanhatu, manomwe, masere, mapfumbamwe, gumi, gumi nerimwe.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.2: Akaverenga mutsara wepazasi kubva kuruboshwe, achienderera: gumi nemaviri, gumi nematatu, gumi nemana, gumi nemashanu.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.3: Nhamba yekupedzisira yakaverengwa i gumi nemashanu, saka pane 15 pamwe chete.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 3 hauna kururama. Mutsara wepazasi une masitikari 5, asi akaverenga 4 chete: gumi nemaviri, gumi nematatu, gumi nemana, gumi nemashanu. Gumi nematanhatu rakasiiwa. Mitsara 1 ne2 yakaverengwa kuenderana nenhamba iri mumutsara wega wega, uye mutsara 4 wakangodzokorora nhamba yekupedzisira yakaverengwa kare, saka haisi kukanganisa munzira yekuverenga pachayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.prompt: Nari akati 17. Fungidzira kwakangoita Nari kukanganisa, uye unyore nzira yekuverenga inogona kudzivirira kukanganisa kumwe chete.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga watarisa kana 17 iri huru kana diki kupfuura 16, uye ufunge kana chimwe chasiiwa kana chakaverengwa zvakawandisa.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti chiratidzo chakaita sei pazvakaverengwa chingakudzivirira kuverenga sitikari imwe chete kaviri.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kana ndikashandisa nzira yandakanyora, inogona kudzivirira zvose kukanganisa kwaJihu nekukanganisa kwaNari here?
z-m-04-02.s.s3.model.0: Zvinoita sekuti nyeredzi imwe chete yakaverengwa kaviri. Kana ukaverenga uchiita maka madiki panyeredzi dzawakaverenga, hauzoverengi kaviri kana kusiya.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.model.1: Zvinoita sekuti imwe yakaverengwa kamwe zvakare pakati pemutsara wepakati newepazasi. Kana ukaverenga mutsara wega wega wega ukaunyora, wobva waubatanidza gare gare, unogona kuwana mutsara wakaipa.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Kuverenga mutsara wega wega uye kuunyora

z-m-04-04.title: 'Zvakawanda zvikuru' zvinogara zvichikunda zvimwe zvose here?
z-m-04-04.topic: Kugadzira counterexample: kuenzanisa chinhu chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru nezvimwe zvose pamwe chete
z-m-04-04.goal: Gadzira tebhura umo chirevo che 'chiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru chinogara chiine zvakawanda kupfuura zvimwe zvose pamwe chete' chisingashande, uye utaure mamiriro umo chirevo chinova chakarurama.
z-m-04-04.material: Shamwari 12 dzakasarudza chiitiko chadzinoda kuita pa picnic. Zviitiko ndezvekutsvaga hupfumi, kusvetuka rwodzi, nemitambo yebhora. Vose 12 vakasarudza chinhu chimwe chete. Hayun akati, "Chiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru chinogara chiine zvakawanda kupfuura shamwari dzakasarudza zviitiko zvimwe zviviri pamwe chete!" Fungidzira kuti pane chiitiko chimwe chete chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru, uye hachina kuenzana nechimwe chiitiko.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.prompt: Chirevo chaHayun chinogara chakarurama here? Usati wagadzira tebhura, sarudza kufunga kwako.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isa nhamba diki imwe uye unyore nyaya imwe.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.hint.1: Isa padivi nedivi nhamba yechiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru nenhamba yaunowana kana ukawedzera zviitiko zvimwe zviviri.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.a: Inogara yakarurama. Chiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru chine zvakawanda kupfuura zviitiko zvimwe
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.a: 'Zvakawanda kupfuura chiitiko chimwe nechimwe chimwe' ne 'zvakawanda kupfuura zvimwe zvose pamwe chete' hazvireve chinhu chimwe chete.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.b: Hazvioneki sekuti inogara yakarurama. Ndichaiedza nekuisa nhamba
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.b: Wakaona kuti chirevo chinoti 'nguva dzose', saka chakakodzera kuedzwa. Maitiro ekuongorora nenhamba.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.c: Nhamba yevanhu yakagadzikwa. Fungidzira kana unogona kuziva nekuisa nhamba.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.explain: Izwi re 'nguva dzose' rinogona kuputswa nemuenzaniso mumwe chete. Unogona kuziva nekuedza netebhura yawakagadzira iwe amene. Mudzidzi akati 'handizivi' pakutanga anogona kutongawo mushure mekugadzira tebhura.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.acc.0: Pakutanga unogona kusaziva. Unogona kuziva nekugadzira tebhura uye kuedza. Zvakanaka kana uchida kuedza.
z-m-04-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira matebhura 3 umo chirevo chaHayun chisina kururama. Nyora nhamba yeshamwari dzechiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru se a, chechipiri se b, nechechitatu se c. (a, b, ne c nhamba dzechisikigo dziri 0 kana kupfuura, uye zvitatu zvose zvinowedzera kuita shamwari 12.)
z-m-04-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza nhamba a yeshamwari dzechiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru.
z-m-04-04.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga shamwari dzakasarudza zviitiko zvimwe zviviri pamwe chete uye uenzanise ne a.
z-m-04-04.s.s2.hint.2: Haifanire kuva neruenzanisa. Ongorora kuti a yakakura kupfuura b ne c.
z-m-04-04.s.s2.var.a: Nhamba yeshamwari dzechiitiko chakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru (a)
z-m-04-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba yeshamwari inhamba yechisikigo i0 kana kupfuura.

z-m-04-08.title: Mabhatani akafanana, asi rinowanzoitika rakasiyana
z-m-04-08.topic: 'Rakawanda zvikuru' rinochinja zvichienderana nechiyero: ruvara, chimiro, rudzi
z-m-04-08.goal: Dzidza kuti kana ukarongedza mabhatani akafanana nokuruvara, nechimiro, kana norudzi runoverenga ruvara nechimiro pamwe chete, 'akawanda zvikuru' anogona kusiyana, wobva wasarudza chiyero chinowirirana nomubvunzo uye ugadzire mubvunzo mutsva.
z-m-04-08.material: Pane mabhatani 12 muchitoro chemabhatani. Bhatani rega rega riri rimwe rinoruvara rutsvuku, bhuruu, kana yero, uye rine chimiro chedenderedzwa kana chekatatu. [Tafura] Denderedzwa tsvuku 2 / Katatu tsvuku 3 / Denderedzwa bhuruu 4 / Katatu bhuruu 0 / Denderedzwa yero 1 / Katatu yero 2. Pamwe chete zvinoita 12. Minjun akaverenga nokuruvara uye akaverengawo nechimiro.
z-m-04-08.thinking.0: Kurongedza data rimwe chete nezviyero zvakati wandei uye kuenzanisa
z-m-04-08.thinking.1: Kuparadzanisa zvinotaurwa nechiyero chega chega nezvisingatauri
z-m-04-08.s.s1.prompt: Uku ndiko Minjun akafunga. Sarudza mutsetse wakanganisa.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga uye uverenge nhamba iri mubhokisi re 'denderedzwa tsvuku' retafura.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti ndeipi pamabhokisi matanhatu ine nhamba huru zvikuru.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.line.0: Ndakaverenga nokuruvara: tsvuku 5, bhuruu 4, yero 3. Ruvara rune akawanda zvikuru ndi tsvuku.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.line.1: Ndakaverenga nechimiro: denderedzwa 7, katatu 5. Chimiro chine akawanda zvikuru ndi denderedzwa.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.line.2: Saka 'denderedzwa tsvuku' ndiro bhatani rine akawanda zvikuru.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.line.3: Kunyange ukaverenga nokuruvara kana nechimiro, zvose ndi 12.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 wakashata. Mutafura mune denderedzwa tsvuku 2 chete. Kubatanidza ruvara rune yakawanda zvikuru (tsvuku) nechimiro chakawanda zvikuru (denderedzwa) hakuiti rudzi rwebhatani rwakawanda zvikuru. Kana ukaverenga rudzi apo ruvara nechimiro zvose zvakafanana, denderedzwa rebhuruu ndiro rakawanda zvikuru ne4. Mitsara 1 ne2 inosangana netafura, uye mutsara 4 wakarurama zvakare.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvirevo zvose zvinosangana nezvinoda muridzi wechitoro chemabhatani netafura yakarurama.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wataura kana mubvunzo uchibvunza nezveruvara, nezvechimiro, kana nezvezvose zviviri.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga, imwe imwe, kuti tafura ipi inoratidza nhamba dzinodiwa nemubvunzo.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.o.a: Kuti usarudze 'Tinofanira kutenga mabhokisi echimiro chipi zvakawanda?', unogona kutarisa tafura yakarongwa neruvara
z-m-04-08.s.s2.r.a: Tafura yakaverengwa neruvara haioneki nhamba dzechimiro chimwe nechimwe. Enzanisa zvinobvunzwa nemubvunzo nezvinoudzwa netafura.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.o.b: Kuti usarudze 'Tinofanira kutenga tambo yeruvara rupi zvakawanda?', unogona kutarisa tafura yakarongwa neruvara
z-m-04-08.s.s2.r.b: Mubvunzo unobvunza nezveruvara, saka wakasarudza tafura yakaverengwa neruvara.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.o.c: Kune mubvunzo upi neupi, tafura imwe yakarongwa neruvara inokwana
z-m-04-08.s.s2.r.c: Wakafunga kuti tafura imwe inogona kupindura mibvunzo yose. Mibvunzo yakasiyana inogona kuda matafura akasiyana.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.o.d: Kana ukabatanidza ruvara rune yakawanda zvikuru nechimiro chakawanda zvikuru, unowana rudzi rwakawanda zvikuru
z-m-04-08.s.s2.r.d: Tarisazve mumabhokisi etafura kana kubatanidza zvakawanda zvikuru muruvara nezvakawanda zvikuru muchimiro kuchishanda.
z-m-04-08.s.s2.o.e: 'Tinofanira kuzadza bhatani rei kutanga?' inoda kuti utarise mabhokisi ose matanhatu
z-m-04-08.s.s2.r.e: Wakafunga kuti mubvunzo unotarisa ruvara nechimiro pamwe chete unoda tafura inoverenga ruvara nechimiro zvose.

Tafura imwe haigoni kupindura mibvunzo yose.
z-m-04-08.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira mumwe mubvunzo waungabvunzwa nemuridzi wechitoro chemabhatani. Nyorawo kuti tafura ipi inokodzera mubvunzo iwoyo, yakaverengwa neruvara, nechimiro, kana neruvara nechimiro pamwe chete, uye nei.
z-m-04-08.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira zvinoda kutenga muridzi wechitoro chemabhatani.

z-m-04-05.title: Tsvakurudzo yemavara aunoda: ndeapi mabhokisi atinoda?
z-m-04-05.topic: Kusarudza zvinhu zvetsvakurudzo: kugadzira mabhokisi anogona kumakwa nemunhu wose pasina anosiiwa
z-m-04-05.goal: Dzidza dambudziko rinomuka kana bhokisi retsvakurudzo risina chinhu, gadzira iwe amene mabhokisi kuti shamwari yega yega ive nebhokisi rimwe rekumaka, uye utaure muganhu webhokisi idzva rinoonekwa.
z-m-04-05.material: Vadzidzi 20 vomukirasi yaMinho vari kuita ongororo ye 'ruvara rumwe rwaunoda'. Munhu wega wega anoisa chiratidzo mubhokisi rimwe chete. Minho akagadzira mabhokisi matatu chete paforomu yeongororo: 'tsvuku', 'bhuruu', ne 'yero'.
z-m-04-05.prereq.0: Kuisa zviratidzo nokuverenga mumabhokisi akaparadzaniswa patafura (nhanho yeGiredhi 1)
z-m-04-05.prereq.1: Kunzwisisa mamiriro okuti munhu wega wega anosarudza chinhu chimwe chete
z-m-04-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana vanhu 20 vachiisa zviratidzo mumabhokisi matatu aya chete, chii chingaitika?
z-m-04-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa rimwe panguva imwe kana ruvara rwega rwega ruri pakati pemabhokisi matatu.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.a: Kana ukaverenga zviratidzo zvose mumabhokisi matatu, zvinofanira kuva 20
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.a: Pangava neshamwari dzisina bhokisi rokuisa chiratidzo. Tanga wanyora kana shamwari yega yega ingasarudza bhokisi.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.b: Shamwari ine ruvara rwaunoda rwegirini haina sero yokuisa chiratidzo
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ndakaenzanisa mavara anodiwa neshamwari nemasero etafura yeongororo rimwe panguva imwe.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.c: Pane masero matatu chete, saka ongororo haigoni kuitwa zvachose
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.c: Kuva nemasero mashoma hakureve kuti ongororo haigoni kuitwa. Tarisa riini masero anova dambudziko chaizvo.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.d: Tsvuku ichawana zviratidzo zvakawanda, saka masero mamwe haadikanwi
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.d: Uri kufungidzira mhedzisiro yemabhokisi pamberi penguva. Parizvino, chinhu chekutanga ndechokuti shamwari yega yega inogona kuisa chiratidzo here.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.explain: Kana pane mabhokisi matatu chete, shamwari ine ruvara rwaunoda risiri rimwe remarudzi matatu, se girini kana pepuru, haina bhokisi rokuisa chiratidzo. Wobva wava kunyange ukaverenga zviratidzo zvose, hazvingasvike 20.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.prompt: Unofanira kugadzira mabhokisi sei kuti vanhu vose 20 vakwanise kuisa chiratidzo pamavara avanoda? Nyora mazita emabhokisi, uye unyorewo kuti sei wakaagadzira nenzira iyoyo.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kana pane shamwari pakati pe 20 ine ruvara rwaunoda risiri tsvuku, bhuruu, kana yero, funga kuti ichaisa chiratidzo mubhokisi ripi.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kana ukagadzira bhokisi rimwe zvakare, nyora zita raro raifanira kuva zvokuti vose vakwanise kuisa chiratidzo.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kunze kwemabhokisi etsvuku, bhuruu, neyero, ndinogadzira bhokisi re ... Nokuti ...
z-m-04-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mumabhokisi andakagadzira, vanhu vose 20 vanogona kuisa chiratidzo mubhokisi rimwe here?
z-m-04-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Pane nyaya apo munhu mumwe anofanira kuisa chiratidzo mumabhokisi maviri here?
z-m-04-05.s.s2.model.0: Ndichagadzira mabhokisi etsvuku, bhuruu, yero, girini, nemamwe mavara. Kana paine bhokisi re 'mamwe mavara', munhu wega wega anogona kuisa chiratidzo pasinei nokuti anoda ruvara rupi.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.model.1: Tanga wabvunza shamwari mavara aanoda, uye ugadzire bhokisi roruvara rwega rwega runobuda. Wobva wava kusina shamwari isingagoni kusarudza nokuti hapana bhokisi.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.prompt: Minho akagadzirisa mabhokisi kuva 'tsvuku, bhuruu, yero, girini, mamwe mavara' uye akaongorora vanhu 20. Mhedzisiro ndi tsvuku 4, bhuruu 4, yero 3, girini 3, uye mamwe mavara 6. Jisu akati, "Mamwe mavara ane 6, akawanda zvikuru, saka mamwe mavara ndiwo ruvara runodiwa zvikuru." Chirevo chaJisu chinofanira kugadziriswa sei?
z-m-04-05.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora mavara mashoma angaenderana nebhokisi remamwe mavara.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.hint.1: Funga nyaya apo vose 6 vakasarudza ruvara rumwe chete nenyaya apo vose 6 vakasarudza mavara akasiyana.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.a: Ichokwadi. 6 ndiyo nhamba huru, saka mamwe mavara ndiwo ruvara runodiwa zvikuru
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.a: Wakaenzanisa chete nhamba dziri mumabhokisi. Tanga wafunga kana 'mamwe mavara' ruvara rumwe chete.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.b: Bvisa bhokisi remamwe mavara uye utaure kuti tsvuku nebhuruu zvinodiwa zvikuru
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.b: Kunyange ukabvisa bhokisi, vanhu 6 vakasarudza mamwe mavara havapere. Haugoni kuziva mavara api avakasarudza vanhu 6 ivavo.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.c: Pane masero mashanu, saka mhedzisiro iyi haigoni kuvimbwa
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.c: Kuva nemasero mashoma kana mazhinji hakureve kuti mhedzisiro haigoni kuvimbwa. Tarisa ruzivo rwupi rwunopiwa nemasero.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.d: "Mamwe mavara" isero umo mavara akawanda akasanganiswa, saka haigoni kunzi ruvara rimwe chete
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.d: Wakacherechedza kuti mavara akawanda akaunganidzwa musero rimwe. Wakatarisa poinzi yokuti hatigoni kuziva kana vanhu vose 6 musero vane ruvara rumwe chete.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.explain: 'Mamwe mavara' anogona kuva nemavara akati wandei pamwe chete, se pepuru nepingi. Kana vanhu 6 vakasarudza ruvara rwakasiyana rimwe nerimwe, ruvara rumwe rungave nomunhu 1 chete, uye kana vose 6 vakasarudza ruvara rumwe chete, ruvara rumwe rungave nevanhu 6. Tafura iyi oga haigoni kuratidza kuti ndeipi, saka unofanira kubvunza vanhu 6 ivavo zvakare kuti ndeupi ruvara.

z-m-04-06.title: Kuti utaure kuti zvakawanda zvakadini
z-m-04-06.topic: Kuenzanisa huwandu hwedata maseti maviri: kuenzanisa nokuita mapeya nokuverenga zvakasiyana
z-m-04-06.goal: Enzanisa nzira mbiri dzokuziva 'zvakawanda zvakadini', nokuita mapeya nenhamba dzakaverengwa zvakasiyana, uye ugadzire mhedzisiro dzeongororo dzakasiyana dzine musiyano mumwe chete.
z-m-04-06.material: Shamwari dziri mukirasi imwe neimwe dzakasarudza mhuka imwe yadzinoda, mbwa kana katsi. Shamwari yakasarudza mbwa inoratidzwa ne ○ (denderedzwa), uye shamwari yakasarudza katsi inoratidzwa ne △ (katatu). Shamwari 8 dzakasarudza mbwa uye shamwari 5 dzakasarudza katsi. Seohyeon akaisa mutsetse we ○ nomutsetse we △ padivi pedzimwe, mumwe pamusoro pomumwe.
z-m-04-06.thinking.1: Kugadzira matafura akawanda ane musiyano mumwe chete
z-m-04-06.prereq.0: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwenhamba kusvika pa 20 nokubvisa (nhanho yeGiredhi 1)
z-m-04-06.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa nokuita mapeya rimwe panguva imwe
z-m-04-06.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzakarurama dzokuziva kuti shamwari dzakawanda zvakadini dzakasarudza mbwa kupfuura dzakasarudza katsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.hint.0: Isa 8 ○ ne 5 △ mumwe pamusoro pomumwe uye uzvibatanidze rimwe panguva imwe.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana nhamba dzaunowana kubva panzira dzawakasarudza dzakafanana.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.o.a: Ita mapeya e ○ ne △ rimwe panguva imwe uye uverenge ○ isina mumwe
z-m-04-06.s.s1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa mitsetse miviri rimwe panguva imwe uye wakatarisa zvasara kuti uone musiyano. Iyi inzira yokuenzanisa nokuita mapeya.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.o.b: Verenga pamwe chete shamwari dzose dzakasarudza mbwa nokatsi
z-m-04-06.s.s1.r.b: Nhamba yakaverengwa pamwe chete ndihuwandu hwose hweshamwari dzakaongororwa. Tarisa kana iri nhamba inoratidza 'zvakawanda zvakadini'.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.o.c: Verenga shure kubva pa 8 kusvika pa 5 uye uverenge kuti unopfuura nhanho ingani
z-m-04-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakawana musiyano nokuverenga pakati penhamba mbiri. Inzira yakasiyana nokuita mapeya, asi inzira yokutsvaga musiyano umwe chete.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.o.d: Ingotaura 8, nhamba huru pakati pe 8 ne 5
z-m-04-06.s.s1.r.d: Nhamba huru ndihuwandu hweshamwari dzakasarudza mbwa. Hausati wataura kuti zvakawanda zvakadini.
z-m-04-06.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaita mapeya, ○ 3 dzinosara. Kuverenga shure kubva pa 8 kusvika pa 5 kunewo nhanho 3. Mhinduro dzenzira mbiri dzakafanana, shamwari 3. Huwandu hwakaverengwa, 13, kana nhamba huru, 8, hazvisi 'zvakawanda zvakadini'.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.prompt: Vakaita imwe ongororo nezuva rimwe. Gadzira mhedzisiro 3 dzeongororo umo shamwari 3 chaizvo dzakawanda dzakasarudza mbwa kupfuura dzakasarudza katsi, uye shamwari dzakasarudza mhuka mbiri pamwe chete ndi 15 kana shoma. (Shamwari 1 kana kupfuura yakasarudza katsi.)
z-m-04-06.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza nhamba y yeshamwari dzakasarudza katsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza x kuti, kana yaitwa mapeya ne y yawakasarudza, ○ 3 dzisare.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.hint.2: Tarisa kuti nhamba mbiri dzakabatanidzwa ndi shamwari 15 kana shoma.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba dzeshamwari inhamba dzechisikigo uye shamwari 1 kana kupfuura yakasarudza katsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba dzeshamwari dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzechisikigo, uye shamwari 1 kana kupfuura inofanira kunge yakasarudza katsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Pane shamwari 3 dzakawanda dzembwa kupfuura dzekatsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Shamwari 3 chaizvo dzakawanda dzinofanira kunge dzakasarudza mbwa kupfuura katsi.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Kunyange dzakabatanidzwa, mbiri idzi ndi shamwari 15 kana shoma.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.fail.c3: Shamwari dzakasarudza mhuka mbiri dzinofanira kuwedzera kuita 15 kana shoma.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.explain: Kana shamwari 1 yakasarudza katsi, mbwa ndi 4; kana 5, saka 8; kana 6, saka 9. Munyaya dzose, kana ukaita mapeya e ○ ne △, ○ 3 dzinosara. Huwandu hunofanira kuva 15 kana shoma, saka huwandu hweshamwari dzakasarudza katsi hunogona kusvika pa 6.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Kunyange huwandu hweshamwari dzakasarudza mbwa nekatsi dzakasiyana patafura imwe neimwe, zvinoramba zvichiva zvechokwadi kuti 'pane shamwari 3 dzakawanda dzembwa kupfuura dzekatsi'. Nyora chikonzero nemashoko anoshandisa kuita mapeya e ○ ne △.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Gadzira tafura umo shamwari 1 yakawanda yakasarudza katsi, uiise padivi petafura yekutanga, uye uite mapeya e ○ ne △.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Mushure mokuita mapeya, verenga ○ isina mumwe patafura imwe neimwe yaviri uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti ○ dzingani dzinosara mushure mokuita mapeya?
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here kuti sei huwandu hwe ○ dzinosara huchiramba hwakafanana kunyange shamwari dzakawanda dzichisarudza katsi?
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ukaita mapeya e ○ ne △ rimwe panguva imwe, patafura ipi neipi ○ 3 dzisina mumwe dzinosara. Kunyange zvose zvikawedzera nehuwandu hwakafanana, zvinosara zvinoramba zviri 3.
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.modelNote.0: Huwandu hunosara mushure mokuita mapeya huramba hwakafanana
z-m-04-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Kana shamwari imwe yawedzera kusarudza katsi, shamwari imwe zvakare inosarudza mbwa, saka mushure mokuita mapeya, ○ dzinosara dzichiri 3.

z-m-04-07.title: Pakanga paine mazuva akawanda ezuva vhiki rino, saka vhiki rinotevera richava saizvozvo here?
z-m-04-07.topic: Zvinogona nokusagona kutaurwa nemarekodhi: kufungidzira zvichaitika
z-m-04-07.goal: Dzidza kuti kubva pamarekodhi apfuura unogona kutaura chaiva 'chakawanda zvikuru', asi haugoni kutaura zvirokwazvo zvichaitika, uye utaure kuti kufungidzira kwako kunochinja sei kana uine marekodhi akawanda.
z-m-04-07.material: Wakanyora mamiriro okunze pakarenda yekirasi kwemazuva 5, kubva Muvhuro kusvika Chishanu. Vhiki rino paiva nemazuva ezuva 3, zuva 1 rine mavingu, uye zuva 1 romvura. Yeonseo akati, "Vhiki rino paiva nemazuva ezuva akawanda zvikuru, saka vhiki rinotevera rinewo mazuva ezuva akawanda zvikuru."
z-m-04-07.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuvimba kwako sezvo data rinokura
z-m-04-07.thinking.2: Kuita kusava nechokwadi nezvirevo zvinotaura zvakasimba
z-m-04-07.prereq.0: Kuwedzera nhamba kusvika pa 5 nokuverenga huwandu hwemazuva kubva patafura (nhanho yeGiredhi 1)
z-m-04-07.prereq.1: Mashoko emamiriro okunze se zuva, mavingu, mvura
z-m-04-07.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kana chokwadi chokuti mazuva ezuva akawanda zvikuru murekodhi yevhiki rino nemamiriro okunze evhiki rinotevera chirevo chimwe chete.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kuti zvaizova zvakasiyana sei kana paiva nemarekodhi emamiriro okunze emavhiki mamwe.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.a: Zvingava zvakadaro, asi hatigoni kutaura zvirokwazvo
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakashandisa marekodhi apfuura sechiratidzo asi hauna kusvetukira kumhedziso. Unogona kufunga kuti zvinogona kuchinja sei kana paine marekodhi akawanda.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.b: Marekodhi evhiki rino haatiudzi chinhu pamusoro pevhiki rinotevera
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.b: Marekodhi evhiki rino haasarudzi vhiki rinotevera, asi zvakaipa kutaura kuti hapana chiratidzo zvachose. Chiratidzo nechokwadi zvinhu zvakasiyana.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.c: Zvakadaro vhiki rino, saka vhiki rinotevera zvirokwazvo richarova saizvozvo zvakare
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakatakura marekodhi evhiki rimwe chete kuvhiki rinotevera. Mavhiki mamwe angava akasiyana.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.explain: Rekodhi yevhiki rino chiratidzo chokuti pangava nemazuva ezuva akawanda vhiki rinotevera. Asi nerekodhi yevhiki rimwe chete, haugoni kutaura 'zvirokwazvo' kuti zvichadaro.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.acc.0: Waona zvakanaka kuti rekodhi yevhiki rimwe chete haigoni kusarudza vhiki rinotevera. Asi kuti rekodhi inoshanda sechiratidzo here kunogona kutsvakwa uchiunganidza zvakawanda.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.prompt: Yeonseo akawanawo rekodhi yevhiki rapfuura. Vhiki rapfuura raiva nemazuva ezuva 2, zuva 1 rine mavingu, uye mazuva 2 emvura. Kubatanidza mavhiki maviri (mazuva 10), pane mazuva ezuva 5, mazuva 2 ane mavingu, uye mazuva 3 emvura. Sarudza chirevo chakarurama.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga zvakare mazuva emavhiki maviri nomamiriro okunze uye uanyore patafura.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora zvakasiyana zvaunogona kutaura kubva pamarekodhi nezvausingazivi pamusoro pevhiki rinotevera.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.a: Mazuva ezuva ndiwo akanga ari akawanda zvikuru, saka vhiki rinotevera zvirokwazvo richavawo nemazuva ezuva akawanda zvikuru
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.a: Kunyange wakaunganidza marekodhi emazuva gumi, vhiki rinotevera harisati rasvika. Unounganidza zvakawanda, unowana zvikwangwani zvakawanda, asi haugoni kutaura zvirokwazvo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.b: Mazuva ezuva ndiwo akanga ari akawanda zvikuru, asi hatigoni kuziva pamusoro pevhiki rinotevera
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.b: Waparadzanisa zvinotaurwa nemarekodhi (zvakanga zviri zvakawanda zvikuru) nezvisingatauri (vhiki rinotevera).
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.c: Pakanga paine mazuva emvura akawanda kupfuura mazuva ezuva
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.c: Enzanisa zvakare mazuva ezuva 5 nemazuva emvura 3.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.d: Takaunganidza mazuva gumi, saka vhiki rinotevera pachava nemazuva ezuva 3 chaizvo
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.d: Wakatakura reshiyo yemarekodhi apfuura kuvhiki rinotevera. Kunyange marekodhi akawanda, haugoni kusarudza huwandu chaihwo hwemazuva evhiki rinotevera.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.explain: Murekodhi yemazuva gumi, unogona kutaura kuti mazuva ezuva akanga ari akawanda zvikuru, 5. Asi mamiriro okunze evhiki rinotevera haasati aitika, saka haagoni kusarudzwa. Sezvo marekodhi achikura, chiratidzo chokuti pangava nemazuva ezuva akawanda chinotendeka zvishoma.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvaunogona kutaura pamusoro pemamiriro okunze evhiki rinotevera kubva padata raunaro parizvino, uye zvichiri zvisina chokwadi. Nyorawo kuti marekodhi mapi mamwe aizoita kuti uvimbe chirevo icho zvakanyanya.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa kana mavhiki aiva nemazuva ezuva akawanda zvikuru akafanana mumarekodhi evhiki rino nevhiki rapfuura.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti ungadzidza chii chimwe kana ukaunganidza rekodhi rakafanana kwemavhiki mashoma akawanda.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Muzvandakataura, 'zvatingaziva kubva padata razvino' ne 'zvatisati taziva' zvakaparadzaniswa here?
z-m-04-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Marekodhi andakataura kuti aunganidzwe zvakawanda aizobatsira here pakufungidzira mamiriro okunze evhiki rinotevera?
z-m-04-07.s.s3.model.0: Mazuva ezuva angava akawanda zvikuru, asi hazvisi zvokungoitika. Kana tikaunganidza marekodhi emavhiki akawanda, tinogona kuvimba zvakawanda.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.model.1: Hatisati tazviziva. Mavhiki maviri chete haakwani, saka tinofanira kuunganidza marekodhi emamwe mavhiki uye titarise kuti mazuva ezuva akanga ari akawanda zvikuru kakangani.
